capabilities.name: Artifact fidelity acceptance
capabilities.detail: Suggested procedure checking conversion completeness, reconstruction error, operator agreement and downstream corpus quality against declared budgets.

factory.controlled_experiment.title: Run controlled experiments and qualify the result

capabilities.name: Bounded experiment design
capabilities.detail: Set the falsifiable question, scope, independent oracle, pass criteria, controls and permitted retries before any measurements.

capabilities.name: External trial executor
capabilities.detail: Pin candidate, target and workload, stage each attempt, correlate phase/transfer/kernel observations, retain partial results and clean up.

capabilities.name: Correctness and performance probes
capabilities.detail: Select operator, sequence, task-quality, timing or resource fixtures. Measure target behavior against its own baseline at matched shapes and cache state.

capabilities.name: Reproducible decision record
capabilities.detail: Link raw observations to the exact image, input, configuration and target. Record uncertainty, independent confirmation and failed or unmeasured obligations.
